lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p26 - Listen, point and count.

details: Listen and point shows they match what they hear to the right image. Count practises numbers 1-10.
Look for careful listening, correct pointing, clear sounds, and confident repetition.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p26 - 3. Draw yourself. Talk about your picture with I’ve got…

details: Draw reinforces comprehension of the target vocabulary and allows for personalisation. Students show understanding through simple illustrations that match each written word. Talk gives students the opportunity to personalise and practise pronunciation and full sentences.
Look for neat and careful drawing, clear bookwork, accurate pronunciation and word choice, and correct sentence formation.
